declaration.argument: Only how the scheduler counts eligible runnables and when it scans for pending crashes changes. When no reservation, FIFO link or strict timer gate exists, only a planned crash can be ineligible and it sits only in its own node's local queue, so each queue's eligible count is its length unless that node has a pending crash that is withheld or whose victim is down on a retargeting run, and only such a queue is filtered; the counts, and so every draw and its order, equal a filter of every queue. With no node holding a pending crash, the crash hold and defer loops, the crash-anchor probe and the crash census scan, which draw and record nothing on such steps, are skipped. No draw, value, row, container order or anything the search reads changes. One-thread identity against the baseline binary on VR (3,008 runs), Mencius (2,160 runs), a crash-heavy session (1,800 runs) and a caps-engaged VR session of 100,000 runs with crash holds engaged: every executions, logs and traces parquet file byte-identical, the runs file differing only in wall columns, every table identical, same stall_cap_runs.csv hashes, equal end reasons, steps, cap figures and crash-hold counts, runs_failed 0.
